title: Rural boyhood: fieldwork and the sugar refinery
summary: Thomas describes a rough country childhood working in the fields and the sugar refinery.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: See? And what was your life like out there in the country as a kid?

Well, I had to work. I had to work. Work in the field, you know what I mean? Work in the sugar refinery, you know what I mean? I do a different kind of job, you know? I do a different thing. I did a different thing. I did a different thing. I did everything, you know?
It was kind of rough, you know what I mean?
